title: Quick Stack Charm
description: Right-click any container (chest, barrel, shulker box, hopper, dropper, etc.) while holding the charm and items from your inventory that match types already in that container get pushed in automatically.
body:
Quick Stack is one item, doing one job, well.

Craft a **Quick Stack Charm** from a chest and an ender pearl (shapeless). Hold it and right-click any container — chest, barrel, shulker box, hopper, dropper. Items in your inventory that match types the container **already holds** get pushed in.

## Why "already holds"?
The charm never introduces new item categories to a container. If your iron chest is full of iron ingots, blocks and nuggets, quick-stacking against it will only top up those three. Everything else stays in your inventory. Sorted storage rooms stay sorted; you don't have to clean up afterwards.

## Features

Super simple and easy to use.
**Hotbar protected.** By default the mod skips your hotbar so your tools and food don't get taken. Toggle in the config.
**Soft feedback.** Optional pickup sound and a private chat message telling you how many items moved.


## Compatibility

Works with vanilla containers and any modded storage block that implements the standard Container interface.

## Recipe:

![image](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/null/description_9abf0feb-8bd0-418a-b8c0-c6525b7578e9.png)

Put a chest and an Ender Pearl anywhere in the crafting grid.
